LanguageData.Bullet_DMS_GrenadeLauncher.label: grenade round
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AGL_EMP.label: EMP grenade round
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AGL_EMP.description: A grenade round carrying a discharge capacitor in place of explosive filler. On impact it dumps its charge into everything nearby, seizing up mechanoid systems and turrets without leaving a mark on flesh.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AGL_Smoke.label: smoke grenade round
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AGL_Smoke.description: A screening round that bursts into a bank of obscurant smoke where it lands. It does no damage at all; a few of them in quick succession will blind a firing line long enough for an assault or a withdrawal.
LanguageData.Bullet_DMS_LightMachineGun.label: full-power rifle bullet
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_338Magnum.label: .338 magnum bullet
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_338Magnum.description: A .338 magnum rifle cartridge. It carries far more energy downrange than a full-power battle rifle round while remaining light enough to be fired from a semi-automatic action without a mech-grade recoil buffer.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Slug.label: 12 gauge slug
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Slug.descripti: A single rifled lead slug instead of a spread of pellets. It reaches much further and punches through light plating, but only one projectile leaves the barrel per trigger pull.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Dragon.label: 12 gauge dragon's breath
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Dragon.descrip: A shell packed with zirconium pellets that ignite the moment they clear the muzzle. The burning cloud spends itself within a few paces, which is exactly the distance the loader cares about.
LanguageData.DMS_Bullet_AssaultShotgun_Flechette.desc: A sabot shell holding a bundle of tungsten-cored darts. Each dart carries almost no mass and does little to soft tissue, but the cores hold together against plating that stops a lead pellet cold.
LanguageData.DMS_AntiMaterialRifle.label: Mech AMR
LanguageData.DMS_AntiMaterialRifle.description: A heavy sniper rifle firing large-caliber machine gun rounds, used to snipe targets at long range in engagements against heavily armored units.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
LanguageData.DMS_AntiMaterialRifle.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_AntiMaterialRifle.tools.barrel.label: barrel
LanguageData.DMS_AntiMaterialRifle.tools.muzzle.label: muzzle
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultRifle.label: Mech Assault Rifle
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultRifle.description: An all-metal assault rifle designed specifically for mechs, with a Picatinny rail as long as the gun itself to meet every tactical need.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultRifle.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultRifle.tools.barrel.label: barrel

LanguageData.DMS_AssaultRifle.tools.muzzle.label: muzzle
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.label: Mech Assault Shotgun
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.description:
A fully automatic shotgun able to be mass-produced with stamped components.
This weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.tools.stock.label: stock
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.tools.barrel.label: barrel
The standard three round burst of pellets. Nothing clever about it, and nothing unarmored enjoys standing in front of it.
A single rifled slug in place of the pellet spread. It reaches far further and punches through light plating, at the cost of one projectile per trigger pull.
A sabot load of tungsten-cored darts. Each one carries almost no mass, so flesh barely notices them, but five of them per pull will find their way through plating that shrugs off buckshot outright.

Zirconium pellets that ignite as they leave the barrel. The burning cloud carries only a few paces and does little damage by itself, but four shells of it will set a corridor alight and keep anything from walking down it.
LanguageData.DMS_AssaultShotgun.tools.muzzle.label: muzzle
LanguageData.DMS_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.label: Mech Grenade Launcher
LanguageData.DMS_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.description:
A handheld automatic grenade launcher for clearing out clustered targets.
This weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
Its tripod folds under the receiver, so a drafted operator can set it down into a firing position on the spot and break it back down just as quickly.
LanguageData.DMS_AutomaticGrenadeLauncher.comps.CompA: A high-explosive fragmentation round for clearing out clustered targets. The standard belt.
A capacitor round that stuns mechanoids and turrets in a small radius instead of destroying them. Useless against flesh, and the heavier fuze assembly slows the burst.
A screening round that lays a smoke bank where it lands. Lighter than the explosive rounds, so it flies a little further and comes on target faster.
LanguageData.DMS_BattleRifle.label: Mech Battle Rifle
LanguageData.DMS_BattleRifle.description: An all-metal battle rifle for mechs. Lighter than a heavy machine gun and with an excellent rate of fire, it is used in dangerous mech-versus-mech combat.\n\nThis weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.

LanguageData.DMS_LightMachineGun.label: Mech LMG
LanguageData.DMS_LightMachineGun.description:
A weapon specializing in suppression chambered in a large caliber rifle round.
This weapon is designed specifically for automatroid use; without external equipment or augmented strength, an ordinary human will struggle to use it properly.
Its folding bipod lets a drafted operator drop it into a firing position on the spot, and pick it back up just as quickly.

LanguageData.DMS_MarksmanRifle.label: Mech Marksman Rifle
LanguageData.DMS_MarksmanRifle.description: A semi-automatic sniper rifle with high accuracy and a fast rate of fire. Its excellent stability and muzzle brake design mean that even a human can handle it.
